summary: Frontend-only regression for the 11-item Tasklio change set on mobile viewport (390x844). PRIMARY BUG FIX CONFIRMED: keyboard no longer dismisses while typing in auth-modal — the module-scoped Field component keeps stable identity so Name / Mobile / Confirm mobile / Password / Confirm password all accept full continuous input without losing focus (active element stays on the same testID after each keystroke). Create-account flow: valid submit shows a ~1s ActivityIndicator inside auth-submit, then modal disappears and home renders 'Hii, Test User' with points-badge (0 → 10 after check-in claim). Empty-submit shows 3 per-field red error labels (auth-name-error, auth-mobile-error, auth-password-error). Home shows greeting/subtitle, points+bell, 3 banners (home-banner-fresh/play./daily), 3 mission rows (home-mission-play/earn/checkin). Daily check-in Claim opens game-result popup (no 'Back to home' button, primary button is game-result-claim), tapping it simulates ad then grants points (0→10). Chances system verified on /games/spin — chances-badge starts at 3, decrements per spin, at 0 turns into chances-get-button which opens get-chances-dialog with get-chances-watch that simulates ad and refills to 3. Spin button spins, game-result appears with Claim only. Wallet: wallet-balance renders (270 pts after game earnings), chip select + UPI 'test@okhdfc' + Request Payout → wallet-thanks-dialog → wallet-thanks-ok simulates ad and switches to Payout history tab (new ₹1.00 Pending row visible). Notifications screen renders empty state (compact). Drawer opens (drawer-menu) with smooth entrance. Admin: access-key '9372@Altaf93Tasklio' unlocks; Dashboard has NO Overview card (Banner/Notification controls sit directly below 3 stat cards); Manage sub-tabs are Users/Payout/Config/Settings — LiveCtrl removed; Config sub-tabs are Reward/Chances/Wallet in that order, admin-save-chances button visible in Chances view. No red-screen or console errors.
action_items: MINOR / SPEC CLARIFICATION: On empty Create-Account submit, only 3 red error labels appear — auth-name-error, auth-mobile-error, auth-password-error. auth-confirm-mobile-error and auth-confirm-password-error do NOT appear because validate() only sets those when the confirm value differs from the primary (empty === empty passes). The review request expected all 5 labels; either (a) accept current behavior (mismatch-only is standard UX) or (b) add explicit empty checks in validate() for confirmMobile/confirmPassword when in create mode.
critical_code_review_comments: auth-modal.tsx: Field is now correctly defined at module scope (fixes the keyboard-dismiss root cause). Consider adding React.memo(Field) to further avoid re-renders on unrelated state changes.

auth-modal.tsx submit(): the 1s setTimeout ignores unmount — if the modal closes/unmounts mid-timer, setLoading + showToast fire on an unmounted component. Guard with a mounted ref or replace with useTransition.

chances.tsx / game-result.tsx: showRewardedAd() rejection path is caught only by GameResult's try/finally; GetChancesModal's watch() will hang loading=true forever if the promise rejects — add a try/finally around await showRewardedAd().
admin.tsx: still 700+ lines (unchanged since iteration 6). Splitting into per-tab subcomponents remains recommended.

rca_of_issue: PRIMARY BUG (auth-modal keyboard dismissing after 1 character) — Root cause was Field being declared INSIDE the AuthModal function body. Each parent re-render (from onChangeText → setState) produced a NEW Field component identity, causing React to unmount/remount the wrapping component and the TextInput inside it. On web this loses focus; on native it dismisses the keyboard. FIX applied by main agent: Field moved to module scope (src/components/auth-modal.tsx line 135). Verified: after typing 'Test User' the active element data-testid remained 'auth-name' throughout, same for the mobile/password fields (10 and 4 continuous keystrokes respectively) — no focus loss.
